nodes.name: Client 0.18.0: the NullDull CLI and MCP client now keeps…
nodes.text: Client 0.18.0: the NullDull CLI and MCP client now keeps one login per origin and workspace. Previously, signing in to a second workspace replaced the first, so switching between projects that used different workspaces meant signing in again.

nodes.name: - `login` binds the directory it runs in to the approved…
nodes.text:
- `login` binds the directory it runs in to the approved workspace. Subdirectories inherit the nearest binding.
- `workspaces` lists the workspaces you are signed in to and the one the current directory uses.
- `use WORKSPACE_ID` binds a directory to a workspace you are already signed in to, without a browser login. `use --clear` removes the binding.
- `logout` removes only the selected workspace’s login.

nodes.name: A command chooses its workspace from `--workspace`, then…
nodes.text: A command chooses its workspace from `--workspace`, then `NULLDULL_WORKSPACE`, then the nearest bound directory, then the default login. Bindings and credentials stay in your private configuration directory, never in the repository.

nodes.name: The client offers the update itself and installs it only…
nodes.text: The client offers the update itself and installs it only after you approve the exact version and checksum. Restart or reconnect the MCP server afterwards and run `status` to confirm the workspace.
